comment: A suite that passes in a run of all tests and fails when it is run by itself, because it needs state that another suite leaves in the process. Narrowed to that suite, a mutant's run fails with or without the mutant; the tool reported Killed for a mutant that every run of all tests lets survive, blamed the mutant for 'state left behind', and gave up the destination (RunnerError for the rest). All three mutants survive; the suite is named as one that needs other tests.
